question: After verifying the public ShieldCortex ownership evidence, should staff hide/quarantine, rename, or decline action on the `@kingaiwork/shieldcortex` listing?
rationale: The repository has intake and moderation tools, but applying them changes marketplace publisher trust and requires staff judgment over real-world ownership evidence and user impact.

options.title: Hide or quarantine after verification
options.body: Keep this issue open while staff verifies the claim, then hide or quarantine the disputed listing with an audit note if the impersonation evidence holds.

options.title: Request more proof first
options.body: Ask for additional public-safe or private verification before any registry action if staff cannot confirm the claimant relationship from the provided links.

options.title: Decline or choose rename only
options.body: If staff decides the listing is not impersonation or a rename is sufficient, record that disposition and close after the production state is updated.

recommendation.title: Hide or quarantine after verification
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while staff verifies the claim, then hide or quarantine the disputed listing with an audit note if the impersonation evidence holds.
